answer: Condoms do not cause infertility, cancer, weakness or illness, and they do not get lost in the body or 'stay inside' a woman. They also do not contain HIV. answer: Some condoms are coated with a spermicide called nonoxynol-9. Ordinary condoms without spermicide are the better choice, especially for anal sex or for people at risk of HIV.

title: What a female (internal) condom is
answer: A female condom, also called an internal condom, is a soft, thin pouch with a flexible ring at each end. It is put inside the vagina before sex and lines it, so sperm and germs cannot pass. It protects against pregnancy, HIV and other STIs. A woman can control it herself, and it does not need the man to have a full erection.

title: How combined pills prevent pregnancy
answer: Combined pills contain two hormones, similar to the ones a woman's body makes. Taken every day, they mainly stop the ovaries from releasing an egg each month. They also make the mucus at the cervix thicker, so sperm cannot easily get through. If no egg is released, pregnancy cannot happen. They do not cause abortion.
